fact: The National Council for AI, Quantum Computing and Emerging Technologies approved the National AI Governance Framework with its guides on trustworthy AI and on generative AI, and a circular requiring government bodies to report on AI strategy achievements quarterly.
title: المجلس الوطني للذكاء الاصطناعي يعتمد الخطة التنفيذية لاستراتيجية الذكاء الاصطناعي
